minor_findings.summary: Some Unicode presentation distinctions are normalized.
minor_findings.evidence: The original title uses em dashes and its yield and intermediate custard label use the full-width digit ６; the candidate uses en dashes and ASCII 6 with a space.

minor_findings.summary: The evidence note overstates exact Unicode preservation.
minor_findings.evidence: The candidate claims that Unicode punctuation and Japanese text are preserved as visibly rendered, despite the dash and full-width digit normalizations.

rationale: The multilingual ingredient content, setup, four-operation flow, all completion criteria, and final product remain semantically intact. The detected differences are presentation-form substitutions rather than recipe-semantic changes.
